description: This file contains the Address controller class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform, specifically within the Catalog module. It manages user address operations such as listing addresses, adding, editing, deleting, and displaying address forms, with methods handling form validation, interaction with address models, and rendering views.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: Controller class for managing user addresses within the OpenCart account section, handling CRUD operations and form rendering.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the address overview page, setting up breadcrumbs, loading view with address list.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the action to list user addresses, ensures user is logged in.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve and format the list of user addresses for display.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the address form for adding or editing an address, pre-filling existing data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submission to add or update an address, including validation and session updates.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a user address after validation checks, and updates session data accordingly.
